results.title: [Bug Bounty] `igamc` calls undefined `igam`, silently discarding ~86% of entropy draws and biasing generated secrets
results.author: 0xzunid
results.body_snippet: ## Summary `S.igamc` in `src/functions/bip39_mnemonic.js` calls a bare `igam(a, x)` that does not exist in its scope. `S.igam` exists as a method on the same object, but the call inside `igamc` never references it, so every invocation that takes the `x < 1.0 || x < a` branch throws `ReferenceError: igam is not defined`. That throw is silently swallowed by `generateEntropy`'s `try { S.randomnessTest(b); } catch (e) { f = false; }`, so the 32-byte entropy draw is discarded and a fresh one is gener

results.title: Bug: stdlib.uuid.is_valid accepts non-hexadecimal UUID characters

Predicted from source: true. ## Fix Validate all non-hyphen characters against [0-9a-fA-F]. Add regression tests for invalid hex, length, and hyphen positions. results.body_snippet: The Government of Pitcairn has a new tide gauge at the landing in Bounty Bay, Adamstown. The IOC lists it as PITC (channel SF, last report 2026-11-18 23:57 UTC), and a second older entry Ptcn (BGAN link, "NO DATA"). A Haskoning news release (May 2026) and the Pitcairn Marine Protected Area's post (2026-07-10) describe a sea level monitoring project, with the gauge installed in July 2026. It is not a UHSLC station, and REFMAR does not list it. The history is short and no operator portal was found

results.author: muazzezwq
results.body_snippet: claimTimeout credits the original caller instead of paying it (PayPerCallV8.sol:290): claimable[c.caller] += refunded + slashed; and claim() pays msg.sender only, from its own gas (PayPerCallV8.sol:303-311). results.author: beardthelion
results.body_snippet: Both signing clients follow a same-origin 301, 302 or 303 by rewriting the request to a bodyless GET while keeping the RFC 9421 headers attached. results.author: QueenGiba

results.title: Bounties funded without an intent never get a `maintainerGithubId`
results.author: QueenGiba
results.body_snippet: When no intent matches, the bounty is created with `maintainerGithubId: null`. Disputes by the maintainer are then rejected, and the self-PR filter in `pulls.ts` does nothing. **Where:** `apps/api/src/indexer/apply.ts`, `apps/api/src/auth/wallet.ts` **Acceptance criteria** - When a user links a wallet equal to a bounty's `maintainer`, backfill `maintainerGithubId`. - Do the same lookup at index time for already-linked wallets. - Add tests for both paths.

results.title: A merge on a bounty that is no longer open gives the author no feedback
results.author: QueenGiba
results.body_snippet: `onMerge` returns `not-open` silently when the chain says the bounty is not `Open` (for example, refunded the day before). The contributor thinks they will be paid. **Where:** `apps/api/src/payouts/payout.ts` **Acceptance criteria** - Post one explanatory comment on the PR with the bounty's on-chain status. - Add a test for the `not-open` path.

results.title: Editing a bounty issue does not update its GitHub card
results.author: QueenGiba
results.body_snippet: The `issues.edited` handler updates `issueTitle` and `criteria` in the DB but does not call `refreshBountyCard`. The card comment keeps the old criteria until the next chain event. **Where:** `apps/api/src/worker/dispatch.ts`, `apps/api/src/github/sync.ts` **Acceptance criteria** - Refresh the card for each updated bounty after an `issues.edited` event. - Add a test using a fake GitHub API.

results.title: Editing a PR body to remove "Closes #N" keeps the bounty link
results.author: QueenGiba
results.body_snippet: `handlePullRequest` only adds `PullRequestBounty` links, and when a body has no closing refs it returns early. A PR that drops the reference stays linked and can still trigger a payout when it is merged. **Where:** `apps/api/src/github/pulls.ts` **Acceptance criteria** - On `edited`, `opened` and `synchronize`, remove links for bounties the body no longer references (only while the PR is not merged). - A test covers adding and then removing a reference.

results.body_snippet: ### Task description ## 现有问题 在官网首页的桌面端主导航中： 1. 「开源悬赏」和「开源图书馆」默认显示为白色，其他导航项为灰色，容易被误认为是当前选中项。 2. 鼠标悬停在带下拉菜单的导航项上时，菜单不会展开，需要额外点击。 3. 下拉面板的左边缘与触发按钮不对齐，背景和边框也与深色导航栏缺少视觉衔接。 ## 解决方案 - [ ] 统一未选中导航项的默认文字颜色，保留悬停、键盘聚焦和当前页面的视觉反馈。 - [ ] 桌面端支持鼠标悬停展开。指针从按钮移入菜单时保持展开，离开两者后收起。触屏端使用点击展开和收起，键盘仍可用 Enter 或 Space 打开、Esc 关闭。 - [ ] 桌面端默认将下拉面板与触发按钮居中对齐，靠近视口边缘时调整位置以避免裁切。菜单背景、边框和悬停色沿用主导航的深色主题。 ### Reward currency YIW $ ### Reward amount 90 ### Reward payer yiwei <yiwei@fcc-cd.dev> ### Task source https://open-source-bazaar
